versions.subject: add new rules and fix filter macro
versions.detection:
`cisco_secure_firewall` EventType=FileEvent SHA_Disposition="Malware" FileDirection="Download"
| bin _time span=5m 
| stats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime
        values(URI) as URIs
        values(ClientApplication) as ClientApplications
        values(FileSHA256) as SHA256
        values(FileName) as FileNames
        values(ThreatName) as ThreatNames
        values(ResponderIP) as ResponderIPs
        by InitiatorIP
| where count >= 10
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| `cisco_secure_firewall___repeated_malware_downloads_filter`
